activity.notes: Artemisia II succeeded Mausolus as Hecatomnid ruler of Caria and ruled for roughly two years, conventionally dated 353-351 BCE. Caria remained within the Achaemenid imperial order, but Artemisia's own ruling authority was exercised over the Carian satrapy.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Artemisia II
sources.citation_text: Britannica identifies Artemisia II as ruler of Caria after the death of Mausolus and places her rule in the mid-fourth century BCE.

sources.title: Kadmos — recent scholarship on the Hecatomnid dynasty
sources.citation_text: Modern Hecatomnid chronology places Artemisia II's succession to Mausolus and her approximately two-year rule in 353-351 BCE.
